item.text:
**Bottom Line**
Leans `yes`, but with an important caveat. The 2024 record shows Abiy’s economic portfolio being run by identifiable technocrats, and the major reform agenda was repeatedly fronted by `Ahmed Shide`, `Mamo Mihretu`, and `Eyob Tekalign`. The main weakness is that the reforms were crisis-driven and still needed explicit depoliticization safeguards, so this is not a clean meritocracy story.

**Claims**
- [IMF Executive Board Approves Four-Year US$3.4 billion Extended Credit Facility Arrangement for Ethiopia](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/29/pr24291-ethiopia-imf-exec-board-approves-4yr-us3b-ecf-arr) | IMF | 2024-07-29 | The IMF said Ethiopia’s Homegrown Economic Reform agenda was designed to restore debt sustainability, stabilize macroeconomic imbalances, and lay the foundation for higher, more inclusive, private-sector-led growth. This supports the view that Abiy was backing a technocratic reform agenda rather than a patronage-based one. | `5B.2`, `5B.1`

- [The Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia: Request of an Arrangement Under the Extended Credit Facility](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/07/29/the-federal-democratic-republic-of-ethiopia-request-of-an-arrangement-under-the-extended-552778) | IMF | 2024-07-29 | The staff report says SOE reform would professionalize governance, improve reporting, and strengthen oversight, including appointing government-independent directors for at least one-third of CBE board seats and using an independent NBE supervisor. That is strong evidence for competence and professionalization, but it also implies the system still needed formal anti-politicization safeguards. | `5B.2`, `4B.4`

- [The National Bank of Ethiopia Announces the Launch of a New Monetary Policy Framework](https://nbe.gov.et/nbe_news/the-national-bank-of-ethiopia-announces-the-launch-of-a-new-monetary-policy-framework/) | National Bank of Ethiopia | 2024-07-09 | NBE said it had enhanced technical capacity, prioritized price stability, and moved to a modern monetary-policy framework using market-oriented tools. This indicates the central bank was being empowered as a technical institution, not treated as a political rewards post. | `5B.2`, `5B.1`

- [The Council of Ministers today approved the draft NBE Proclamation and Banking Business Proclamation](https://nbe.gov.et/nbe_news/the-council-of-ministers-today-approved-the-draft-nbe-proclamation-and-banking-business-proclamation/) | National Bank of Ethiopia | 2024-06-14 | The draft laws were described as strengthening credibility, accountability, transparency, and governance in the central bank and banking sector. This is direct evidence that the reform bloc was trying to build professional economic institutions. | `5B.2`, `4B.4`

- [Ethiopia Holds Global Investors Call to Present Update on Ongoing Economic Reforms](https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5227796) | ENA English | 2024-10-02 | The call was led by State Minister of Finance Eyob Tekalign, who presented the macroeconomic outlook, debt restructuring path, and reform pillars for sustainable and inclusive growth. This is direct evidence that a trained economic professional was publicly empowered to run the program. | `5B.2`, `5B.1`

- [IMF Reaches Staff Level Agreement on the Second Review of the Extended Credit Facility for Ethiopia](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/11/27/pr24444-ethiopia-imf-reaches-staff-level-agreement-second-review-ecf) | IMF | 2024-11-27 | IMF staff said they met with Finance Minister Ahmed Shide, NBE Governor Mamo Mihretu, and State Minister Eyob Tekalign, and praised the authorities’ strong action to keep the program on track. This supports the reading that the economic file was handled by a visible technocratic team rather than by opaque loyalists. | `5B.2`, `5B.1`

- [Ethiopia’s IMF deal paves way for debt restructuring, official says](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/ethiopias-imf-deal-paves-way-for-debt-restructuring-official-says-3543214) | Reuters | 2024-07-30 | Reuters reported that the birr float and IMF deal were the route back to debt restructuring after a long delay. This is positive for competence and reform execution, but it also shows the agenda was crisis- and creditor-driven rather than a fully settled long-term meritocracy. | `5B.2`, `5B.1`

**Search Gap**
- I did not find reliable 2024 reporting that Abiy staffed the top economic posts with family members, business partners, or obvious ideological yes-men.
- The main counterevidence is indirect: the IMF staff report’s need for independent directors and central bank autonomy suggests that the state still required explicit depoliticization safeguards.
- So the cleanest reading is: `mostly yes on competence and empowerment`, but `not fully depoliticized`, and the reform team was operating under severe crisis pressure.
